summary_1line: After Rama kills Khara, sages celebrate him while the demon Akampana informs Ravana, who begins plotting to abduct Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita joyfully embraces Rama in the hermitage while slain demons lie scattered and sages gather around the victorious hero.
Ravana, eyes blazing red with fury, leans forward on his throne as the trembling demon Akampana reports the destruction of Janasthana.
Ravana’s radiant chariot drawn by mules races across the sky toward Maricha’s hermitage, shining like the sun among clouds.
